Name: Avalos' Haley Portrait
Author: Avalosssss
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This portrait mod replaces Haley’s basic portraits with my own style of her, I'm using an anime inspired style with some of my own personal touches. It includes all of Haley’s regular expressions for normal dialogue and events. Beach and winter portraits are not included yet, but I plan to add them in a future update. [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Extract the mod ZIP file into your Stardew Valley [/color]Mods [color=#D4D4D8]folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Enjoy the new Haley portraits![/color]


[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
This mod requires:

• SMAPI
• Content Patcher

Make sure both are installed before adding the portrait mod to your Mods folder. The mod is made to work with the latest version of Stardew Valley.



This mod was made entirely by me, Avalos. Thanks for checking out my work and giving the mod a try. I hope you enjoy seeing Haley with a new look! [/*]
